# Figure Catalog

## Analytical figures generated by MATLAB

The main MATLAB script can generate the following figures:

| Figure | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `F1_comm_vs_N.png` | Communication time versus number of submodules |
| `F2_scaling_laws.png` | Computing time of control layers versus N |
| `F3_utilization.png` | Schedulability utilization U(N) |
| `F4_feasibility_heatmap.png` | N_max heat map by technique and platform |
| `F5_gantt.png` | Gantt chart at selected N |

## Editable DrawIO figures

```text
figures/drawio/gantt_MCU_bubble_style.drawio
figures/drawio/gantt_FPGA_bitonic_style.drawio
figures/drawio/gantt_decentralized_style.drawio
```

## PNG previews

```text
figures/previews/gantt_MCU_bubble_style_preview.png
figures/previews/gantt_FPGA_bitonic_style_preview.png
figures/previews/gantt_decentralized_style_preview.png
```

The PNG files are binary previews. Use the prepared ZIP or local Git push to upload them if they are missing from GitHub.
